items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: I heard him say many days, I didn't take those guys.

ctx.x: When he came from New Orleans did he make an impression right away? Was he able to play well enough that he decided he was a pretty good band?

Oh, Jimmy, Jimmy, Jimmy, as far as I know, Jimmy came out here, he was known as one of the best low-known men anywhere. He stayed at the low register and he was hit, as far as I know, he was hit. A lot of guys wanted him but he picked, he'd take some other band but he didn't like him, he didn't like the style of play, he wouldn't live. I heard him say many days, I didn't take those guys. He wasn't the kind of band he liked to play. A band that wasn't too noisy but he was at low register. I mean that's what made…
Who were the other clarinets that impressed you around Chicago when you were here?
